text:
Alex W.: Observed sharp spike in 502/504 from hosted inference in eu-west2 starting ~2026-03-17T10:23Z. Customer-facing errors, multiple support tickets. API latency + results timeouts.
Dani S.: Seeing packet loss counters bump on eth* in eu-west2-a around same time. 3-4% pps drop, retransmits up. :rotating_light:
Priya S.: Escalation from AcmeCorp and BrightHealth — they see repeated `502 Bad Gateway` and auth retries when hitting /v1/generate. Repro steps from customer:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
=> 502 Bad Gateway after ~2.1s
```
Jamie (eng): Traces show upstream gateway timing out at 2s, backend inference nodes respond fine when called directly. Connection resets between lb-eu-west2 and transit 10.12.0.0/16.
IncidentBot: [ALERT] Hosted API eu-west2: 5xx rate > 10% for 5m, impacted routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat (alerts/INC-20260317-92)
Dani S.: Collected pcap on gw-02-eu2-a -> stored s3://redwood-incidents/3032101111/pcap.gz. Quick grep shows bursts of duplicate ACKs and out-of-order packets. Likely microbursts or upstream provider flap.
Alex W.: Is this cross-AZ only? Any evidence of BGP churn?
Jamie (eng): BGP table changes logged for transit-peer-3 at 10:22:58Z with AS path prepends, short-lived withdraws. Correlates with packet anomalies.
Priya S.: Customers asking for ETA. Suggested mitigation to them: enable "region_failover": eu-west1 for their routes. Can SRE do temporary routing policy to steer traffic?
Dani S.: Initiating traffic steering to eu-west1 on canary subset (5%). Also increasing gateway timeouts to 5s for hosted tier while we investigate.
Jamie (eng): Opening ticket with transit provider (ticket #TP-9248) — attaching pcap and BGP logs. Also rolling config to favor alternate peering for eu-west2 for 30m.
Alex W.: Support to inform affected customers and offer credits. Engineering: keep monitoring and post updates every 15m in this thread.
Priya S.: Noted, will send customer-facing status update and add repro steps. Ping me when provider confirms.
Dani S.: Follow-ups: escalate to network infra oncall if packet loss persists after routing changes. Next update in 15m.
